context.hint: Check redirect credential handling separately for each selected downloader.
context.surface: A shell tool selects a downloader to fetch artifacts from a configured authenticated mirror.
assumptions: Use synthetic credentials and two disposable local HTTP fixtures.

review.invariant: A credential attached for the configured mirror cannot reach another origin through an alternate downloader.
review.verification: Use local fixtures to record credential receipt across an origin-changing redirect. Require the downloader to enforce the boundary or deny the unsupported authenticated configuration.

source_observation.summary: The real alternate downloader forwarded the synthetic credential on baseline. The repaired branch denied the unsupported authenticated request and the second fixture received no credential.
